description: This file defines the ErrorMiddleware class of the Slim framework, responsible for intercepting and handling errors and exceptions during HTTP request processing. It implements middleware behavior, manages error handlers, and provides mechanisms to customize error responses.

classes.name: ErrorMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for handling errors and exceptions within Slim framework projects, providing customizable error handling routines and integration with PSR-7 and PSR-15 standards.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Executes the next handler and catches any thrown exceptions to handle errors.

methods.name: handleException
methods.description: Handles exceptions thrown during request processing, delegating to specific error handlers based on exception type.

methods.name: getErrorHandler
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate error handler for the specified exception type, considering subclasses and explicit handlers.

methods.name: getDefaultErrorHandler
methods.description: Lazily instantiates and returns the default error handler.

methods.name: setDefaultErrorHandler
methods.description: Sets a custom callable, string, or ErrorHandler instance as the default error handler.

methods.name: setErrorHandler
methods.description: Associates specific exception types with handlers, enabling custom error responses for different error classes.

methods.name: addErrorHandler
methods.description: Internal method to associate a handler with a specific exception type, distinguishing between direct handlers and subclasses.
